scope: repository-only; deployed rules NOT verified; no emulator run in this task
summary: Existing rules have ownership, verified identity, membership and audit-linked writes; they do not establish authorization for the new server agent, private attachments or notifications. This provisional integration score is not a rating of deployed rules.

findings.issue: No authenticated administrative access to inspect the currently deployed rules or verify they match the repository
findings.recommendation: Read deployed release/ruleset with approved read-only access before any activation

findings.issue: New agent operations, attachment access, recipient consent and notification lifecycle are implemented only in the isolated demo server
findings.recommendation: Implement and emulator-test production server authentication, ACL checks and storage boundaries before connecting Firebase

findings.issue: Preview uses finite synthetic fixture hashes and local extraction; no general upload scanning or production retention policy exists
findings.recommendation: Approve and test general private storage, file isolation, scanning, quotas and deletion policy separately
